summary: 120-foot steel tower in Charlotte County, Virginia; 1930s build, with a June 1937 CCC dispatch showing construction; still owned by the Virginia Department of Forestry.

events.note: CCC dispatch dated June 10, 1937 shows a 120-foot tower under construction on U.S. 360; register says built in the 1930s; no completion date found; the quoted dispatch text does not name the tower
Registered September 3, 2014; nominated by Kristin Scholetzky

evidence.supports: 120-foot steel tower built in the 1930s, first for the lumber industry
evidence.quote: The Crafton Gate Lookout Tower is a 120-foot steel tower built in the 1930's, originally as a lookout for the thriving lumber industry in Charlotte County, as was the Phenix Fire Tower.

evidence.supports: administered by Virginia Department of Forestry
still owned by the Department of Forestry
evidence.quote: It is still owned by them today.

evidence.supports: crew constructing 120 ft steel fire tower on US 360 between Keysville and Wylliesburg
evidence.quote: the crew now constructing the 120 ft. steel fire tower on U.S. highway No. 360, about midway between Keysville and Wylliesburg
Camp Gallion Dispatch - CCC, Company 1390, Green Bay, Va.

evidence.supports: Virginia Department of Forestry listed on site

evidence.quote: Crafton Gate Charlotte 36.90965 -78.52834 Tower Standing NHLR US 1035, VA 15

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says built in the 1930s. The June 1937 dispatch shows construction under way, but the quoted text does not name the tower and gives no completion date. Both fit a 1937 build; the Crafton Gate link is the Forest Lookouts site's.

notes_for_editor: The 1937 dispatch is the only dated primary-type source and does not name the tower; the Crafton Gate link rests on the Forest Lookouts page. Build year is inferred from the dispatch and the register's 1930s, so the event is flagged as approximate. No staffing, fire, condition or access sources found in two searches. Phenix Fire Tower is mentioned by the register but was not researched.
